senses.gloss:
म्ला म्ला॑यति म्ला॑य˚ते (म्लाति) pp. म्लात॑ & म्लान
(q.v.) relax, languish, wither, fade, decay. C. म्लाप॑यति cause to
wither or languish^1, weaken. —परि, प्र, वि = S. — Cf. आम्लान &
परिम्लान.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
म्लात॑ a. made soft by tanning.
म्लानि f. withering, decay, languor, dejection.
